verdict.rationale: Attio's docs state it exposes a public OpenAPI specification for its REST API at https://api.attio.com/openapi/api, and that URL serves a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document with schemas for objects, records, lists and webhooks. The probe 404s were on guessed docs.attio.com paths, not the documented URL, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or third-party corroboration that the spec is complete and stays in sync with the live API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
